readings: Across all fee records with rebrate strictly greater than 0.0005, return one row with (1) the sum of rebtotal, ignoring null rebtotal values, and (2) the average of the per-record difference (feerate - rebrate), computed only over records where both feerate and rebrate are non-null, so records with a null feerate are excluded from this average. Both values are unrounded, and a value is NULL if there is nothing to aggregate.

Across all fee records with rebrate strictly greater than 0.0005, return one row with (1) the sum of rebtotal, ignoring null rebtotal values, and (2) the average of feerate minus the average of rebrate, where each average is computed independently over its own non-null values among those records (so a record with a null feerate still counts toward the rebrate average). Both values are unrounded, and a value is NULL if there is nothing to aggregate.
queries: SELECT SUM(rebtotal) AS total_rebtotal, AVG(CASE WHEN feerate IS NOT NULL AND rebrate IS NOT NULL THEN feerate - rebrate END) AS avg_rate_diff FROM fees WHERE rebrate > 0.0005
